Hi Sara & team — thanks for the clear targets and timeline. I put together an annotated benchmark and recommended pricing bands (high level) below — added the detailed CSV to the attachment for model-by-model assumptions.

Executive summary (estimates, model- and QoS-dependent):
- OpenAI (managed high-capacity models): effective $/1M tokens ≈ $900–$1,400 for conversational-style workloads at our latency assumptions.
- Anthropic (managed): roughly in the same ballpark, often slightly higher on long-context conversational variants (~$1,000–$1,600/1M).
- Generic open-model hosts (managed): wide variance depending on instance sizing and quantization; ballpark $500–$1,200/1M when using optimized quantized variants and shared capacity.
- Self-hosted / Private deployments (customer-managed infra): unit-cost can drop materially (estimated $300–$700/1M) but requires ops overhead, cold-start risk, and more engineering to maintain KV cache and autoscaling.

Redwood recommended bands for Olive Analytics (given your profile & SLOs):
- Pilot (0–3 months, 20M/mo): $1,000/1M tokens (one-month pilot rate; includes prefix caching enabled and basic support)
- Committed (12-month ramp, starting at 40M/mo): $700/1M tokens (volume-committed tier; includes batching and KV cache tuning to reduce token cost)
- Enterprise private + support (if you host private with a commit): effective $480/1M tokens (includes license + support but excludes raw infra cost)

Notes and assumptions:
- All figures are ballpark estimates and depend on chosen model family, quantization, and whether you need strict p50/p95 latency SLOs.
- The OpenAI/Anthropic numbers are effective comparison points (public list prices + observed host surcharges) and are model-dependent; I included the per-model lines in the CSV.
- We assume 2.5 tokens/word for your embedding/LM mix in the detailed sheet.

Attached: 1m_benchmarks_v2.csv (detailed lines by model, assumed throughput, and infra assumptions), redwood_pricing_heatmap_v1.pdf (one-pager).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll turn this into a 3-tier schedule mapped to your month-by-month growth and send by EOD.
2) If your finance team can confirm which band they prefer (pilot vs committed vs private), I’ll route for discount approval and draft a short pilot addendum to speed procurement.

Would you prefer a short (20 min) sync tomorrow to walk the spreadsheet with Mark and Procurement?

Best,
Soojin
